en.title: Accessibility Digest: Taiwan Health Reform, Taichung Awards, Beijing Transit Gains, MS Mental Health Training
en.summary: Taiwan's health reform pushes inclusive policies for disability accessibility; Taichung's public buildings win two-year accessibility excellence award; Beijing reports over half of its ground buses are now accessible; and an online training on mental health, multiple sclerosis and accessibility runs May 18‑22, 2026.

highlights.title: Taiwan’s Health Revolution Boosts Inclusion Call
Taichung Wins Two-Year Championship! Public Buildings' Accessible Environment Receives Central Excellence Award, Urban Development Bureau Promotes Human-Centric Livable City
Beijing continues to optimize accessible travel services, proportion of accessible ground bus models exceeds half - People's Daily
Mental Health, MS & Accessibility Online Training

zh-TW.title: 無障礙每日摘要：台灣健康改革、台中雙年獎、北京無障礙公交、心理健康與多發性硬化症線上培訓
zh-TW.summary: 台灣健康改革推動殘障人士的無障礙政策；台中公共建築連兩年獲得中央無障礙環境特優獎；北京地面公交無障礙車型佔比逾半；以及心理健康、多發性硬化症及無障礙線上培訓將於5月18日至22日舉行。
